summary: Reject missing and failed bootstrap verification instead of false success

delivery.outcome: Generated CI shell command propagates test failures and missing verification; publish through protected validation.
nonGoals: No automatic overwrite of existing user policy
No enabling autonomous mutation or publication without an accepted per-repository scope

architecture.decision: Keep generated CI stages; select a runner using descriptors and availability, then propagate its exit status. Absence of a test runner is a failed verification.
interfaceChanges: Generated CI command exits nonzero when verification cannot pass
architecture.rollback: Revert generated policy change; preserve user policy files.

validation.evidence: Real shell regression tests with isolated PATH and failing/succeeding executable stubs.
